I will put some fertilizer on this maize plot because in Iringa the rains are usually good enough for maize, and on my own land I do not like leaving the plot weak. This plot is very small, so I can manage it with a little purchased fertilizer and some manure from home, and I will plant improved seed because that is what I have seen paying better when fertilizer is not completely skipped. I will keep weeding by hand, not irrigate, and I will not spend money on chemicals unless a real problem comes, so for this season I will not plan for them.
